high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "howandwhyart," which was posted 22 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features a still image from a movie or TV show, showing a character holding a dollar bill with a surprised expression. The text overlay on the image reads: "Seven bucks? Are you serious?" followed by a statement about an MIT study: "95% of firms see zero return on AI investments." The source of the information is credited to "Morning Brew," as indicated by the logo and the text "@morningbrew" at the bottom of the image
